title: The purpose that drives me forward
body_markdown:
Today, I lead a team across the Southeast. It is a blend of people with more than 20 years in this business and people who are newer to the industry. That combination of experience and perspective is one of our strengths.


The newer team members have re-energized me because working with them brings me back to my roots and my first leadership role. At the same time, I get to work with experienced people who remain passionate, skillful and committed to learning. Some members of my team have worked with me at previous companies. There are people I have known professionally for more than 15 years. Those relationships mean a great deal to me.


Being a highly effective leader means creating an environment where great people can do great work. It also means focusing on the right support and development for each person because support looks different in every situation. You have to see people’s strengths and their unique contributions. You have to recognize those qualities if you want to help people maximize their abilities.
